ai_summary: Central Depository Services (CDSL) announced robust Q1 FY27 consolidated financial results, with both total income and net profit growing 15% year-over-year and substantially quarter-over-quarter (27% and 47% respectively). This strong performance is materially impacted by significant business expansion, highlighted by crossing 18.59 crore demat accounts and adding nearly 58 lakh new accounts during the quarter, reinforcing its market leadership. No significant red flags are apparent, though a slight standalone net profit dip was attributed to lower subsidiary dividends.
